clips.title: The story
paras: Margoz sends you into Skull Rock, east of Orgrimmar. Burning Blade cultists have overrun the cave and use painful demonic devices to bind themselves to dark magic. Margoz needs the cursed artifacts to study the cult's presence near the capital.

In northeastern Durotar, cultists gather close to Orgrimmar's gates. The cave lies among the hills, far from the open roads, yet near the Warchief's seat. The Burning Blade, a demonic cult that has long plagued orcish society, has made its home in the tunnels. Its followers perform rituals there while the Warchief's scouts watch nearby.

Burning Blade cultists wear Searing Collars around their necks, metal bands that scorch and brand their flesh. Margoz believes the pain and fel sorcery in the collars attune their wearers to demonic power. He asks you to recover the collars so he can study the spells and bindings that empower the cultists.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend. The Burning Blade has infested the cave east of Orgrimmar known as Skull Rock. Inside that cave they perform vile rituals, and burn their own flesh with Searing Collars.
By wearing these collars, I believe the cultists attune themselves to demonic power. But to confirm this, I must have a collection of the collars to study.
Go to Skull Rock and gather Searing Collars from the cultists you find there. Bring them to me, and I will uncover their secrets.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you yet entered Skull Rock, friend? Do you have the Searing Collars?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good. Hiding within these collars is the secret behind the Burning Blade. And I will uncover that secret...
